name: George W LeMaitre
current_role: Chairman (since 2004) and CEO (since 1992), LeMaitre Vascular Inc. (Nasdaq: LMAT)
profile: Son of vascular surgeon George D. LeMaitre, who founded the company. George W. joined in 1992 as CEO and grew it from a family-owned business into a publicly held global maker of vascular devices (grafts, shunts, valvulotomes), with acquisitions such as Artegraft (2020). His wealth comes from his LMAT stake.
interesting_fact: In Q2 2026 he said Artegraft, LeMaitre's largest product, had become its fastest-growing product, approved in 56 countries and making up 21% of sales.
deep_cut_fact: Before running the family company he earned a B.A. in History from Stanford, worked as a Lehman Brothers investment banking analyst and as an associate at the LBO firm McCown De Leeuw, and was a credit analyst at Connecticut National Bank. He later got a Stanford MBA.
notes: Do not confuse him with his father George D. LeMaitre (founder, died 2018). IR contact named in releases: Gregory Manker, Director of Business Development & IR. Company is based in Burlington, MA.

name: JC Chaudhry
current_role: Founder of Aakash Educational Services Ltd (AESL); Chairman & MD as of 2021; numerologist and motivational speaker
profile: A former botany teacher who started Aakash in 1988 as a small coaching centre in West Delhi. By 2021 it had grown into a national test-prep chain for medical and engineering entrance exams. Byju's agreed to buy Aakash in 2021 for roughly $1bn in cash and stock. He is now also known as a numerologist, author and YouTuber.
interesting_fact: Business Standard reported that he said he did the Byju's deal based on numerology, and that Aakash grew from 12 students in 1988 to 215 centres with more than 250,000 students.
deep_cut_fact: A 1984 debate with his brother-in-law got him into numerology. Using it, he worked out that his real birth date was 18 Nov 1950, not the 1 Aug 1949 his family believed, and confirmed it in 1986 from Faridabad CMO records. He has campaigned for an International Numerology Day on 18 November.
notes: Very public figure through his numerology brand, so his own site and socials are the best route. The Week piece reads as a sponsored feature. The Byju's-Aakash relationship has been contentious, so avoid the topic. I could not verify his current formal title at AESL for 2026.

name: Liao Ronghua
current_role: Chairman (and general manager per 2022 annual report), Shanghai Queclink Wireless Solutions Co., Ltd. (300590.SZ); controlling shareholder
profile: Born January 1976, he holds an engineering master's degree. He worked at ZTE, SIM Technology and SIMCom from 2001 to 2009, then founded Queclink in Shanghai in June 2009. The company makes wireless IoT terminals for vehicle, asset and personal tracking, sells largely overseas, and listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in 2017. He held about 29% of the shares as of May 2026.
interesting_fact: Queclink sells its trackers to North and South America, Europe, Africa and elsewhere through a global network that includes foreign sales staff stationed abroad, which makes it unusually export-oriented for a Chinese IoT hardware maker.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Queclink he spent 2001-2009 at ZTE, SIM Technology (Shanghai) and SIMCom Wireless (Shanghai). His co-founder and vice GM, Peng Wei, followed the same SIM Technology/SIMCom path and joined Queclink at its founding in June 2009.
notes: Also listed in English as Adam Liao or Rong Hua Liao. He chaired the April 2025 board meeting. IoT and telematics hardware angle. Low media profile, so the best route is the board secretary's office (stock@queclink.com).

name: Li Sheng
current_role: Deputy General Manager (since Dec 2016) and Assistant CEO (since May 2024), S.F. Holding; President & Executive Director, SF Airlines
profile: A long-time SF Express executive, aged 59 per the 2025 annual report, with a law degree from Sichuan Normal University. He worked at Wal-Mart China from 1998 to 2005, joined SF in 2005, and rose through regional roles (Hubei, Sichuan, Central and West China) to group VP. He now runs SF Airlines. His wealth comes from his SF Holding equity.
interesting_fact: SF Airlines, which he heads, is at the core of an air network that operated 111 all-cargo aircraft (90 self-operated) at end-2025. The network runs through the Ezhou cargo hub, which SF calls Asia's largest air cargo hub.
deep_cut_fact: Before joining SF he spent seven years (1998-2005) as a senior regional manager at Wal-Mart China. He has also been a director of the SF Foundation, SF's charity arm, since October 2016.
notes: Common name, but the Hurun 'SF' entry matches this SF Holding executive. He is a senior manager, not a founder, so the best route is via SF Holding IR. He has a low personal media profile.

name: Shi Weili
current_role: Chairman & General Manager (since Apr 2013), Wuxi DK Electronic Materials Co., Ltd. (300842.SZ); one of its actual controllers
profile: A materials scientist born in October 1978 with a PhD from SUNY Buffalo (2006). He worked at several US materials companies before returning to lead DK Electronic Materials, a Yixing-based maker of conductive silver pastes for solar cell metallization (PERC, TOPCon, HJT, TBC). DK has since expanded into semiconductor packaging pastes and, through its Jiangsu Jingkai acquisition, memory chips (LPDDR/DDR4).
interesting_fact: DK has led mass-production use of high-copper pastes for TOPCon cells and is developing pure-copper metallization, aimed at cutting the solar industry's dependence on costly silver. It now aims to be a global high-performance electronic materials and memory technology company.
deep_cut_fact: Before taking over DK in 2013 he worked in the US as senior chemist at Evident Technologies (2006-08), project manager at Nano Dynamics (2008-09), researcher/consultant at Henkel (2009-10), and R&D scientist at Ferro Corporation (2010-12).
notes: Strong fit for the energy angle (solar PV materials) and the AI/memory angle. He was US-trained and likely comfortable in English. Best route is IR at ir@dkem.cn.

name: He Cailin
current_role: Chairman and actual controller, Xuelong Group Co., Ltd. (603949.SH), Ningbo
profile: Born February 1947, he is a high-school-educated senior engineer from Ningbo's Beilun district. He built Xuelong from a string of small local electrical-parts and plastic-fan factories into a listed maker of engine cooling fans and auto parts. His daughter He Pinyan, vice chairman and general manager, runs day-to-day operations.
interesting_fact: He led the cooling-fan working group of China's national internal-combustion-engine standardization technical committee, which means the founder of a village electrical-parts workshop helped write national standards for engine cooling fans.
deep_cut_fact: His first ventures were tiny Beilun workshops: he ran the Xiapu Telecom Parts Factory, the Xiapu Jiaoqi Electrical Parts Factory and the Beilun Automotive Plastic Fan Factory before founding Ningbo Xuelong Automotive Fan Factory. He has been named a 'Ningbo Charity Role Model'.
notes: Aged 79 and a family-run company, with his daughter He Pinyan as GM. The board secretary is Zhu Feifei. The bio is matched to the 1947-born chairman entry in the 2025 annual report's director list.
